reviews.review_title: Truly the best customer service I have ever received!
reviews.review_text: Truly the best customer service I have ever had and the pearls are breathtaking! I purchased my wife her first pearl necklace, bracelet and earrings for her 50th birthday. I selected them separately instead of a set, but didn’t think about them coming in 3 different gift boxes, which would be nice for the Wow effect, but challenging to take on her birthday cruise. I reached out to customer service to see if I could purchase a gift set box so that I could combine everything, and not only did they respond quickly, they also had the gift box in the mail and delivered to me in couple of days, free of charge. And, did I mention that the pearls are BEAUTIFUL! Truly heirloom pieces. Hoping I have “Husband of the Year” in the bag (or should I say “gift box”)… Their dedication to excellence has made The Pearl Source my go-to for every pearl I purchase from here on out. Thank you.
reviews.reply_text: Thank you for your thoughtful review. We're delighted that the pearls, gift box, and customer service all helped make your wife's 50th birthday even more special. Thank you for your generous recommendation and support.
